# Explicit invalid library overrides must fail rather than discover another one.
env NVRTC_LIB_PATH=$WORK/missing-nvrtc.so
! exec cudadoctor -json
stdout '"schema": 1'
stdout '"status": "fail"'
stdout 'missing-nvrtc.so'
stdout 'NVRTC_LIB_PATH'
! exec cudadoctor -workflow=tileir -json
stdout '"name": "tileir"'
stdout '"status": "fail"'
! exec cudadoctor -workflow=unknown
stderr 'unknown workflow'
! exec cudadoctor -workflow=aot -smoke=run
stderr 'smoke tests require -workflow=jit'
exec cudadoctor -h
stderr 'workflow'
